nodes.author: KompleteCare
nodes.text: If you notice any of these symptoms in your kids or children around you: Call a doctor immediately on KompleteCare (WHATSAPP 08174290703)

nodes.author: KompleteCare
nodes.text:
What can you do to protect your kids?
✅ Teach them to wash their hands regularly.
✅ Keep sick children at home to prevent spreading.
✅ Watch for symptoms like difficulty in breathing or persistent fever—and don’t delay seeking medical attention.

nodes.author: KompleteCare
nodes.text:
What to watch out for in children:
1. HMPV starts with cold-like symptoms: fever, cough, and nasal congestion.

2. In severe cases, it can lead to pneumonia or bronchiolitis.

3. Kids with asthma or weaker immune systems are especially at risk.

nodes.author: KompleteCare
nodes.text:
It is suspected that there may be a #lockdown soon.
In case you don't know: HMPV (Human Metapneumovirus) is currently on the rise, and children under 5 are the most affected.
